law_definitions.symmetric: All four gains equal: +1/2 or -1/2, each with probability 1/2.
law_definitions.rare_positive: All four gains equal: +15/16 with probability 1/16, otherwise -1/16.
law_definitions.single_null: Coordinate 1 is symmetric +/-1/2; other coordinates equal +1/4.

inference: Each independent stream is one replicate; all tested joint strict-gain claims are false.
